chapters.label: The corner
chapters.text: Wembley, 2021. The Euro final. England lead Italy, one nil. Italy win a corner, and the ball flies into a crowd of players.

chapters.label: Onto the post
chapters.text: Watch again. Verratti heads it at goal. Pickford dives and pushes it onto the post! But Leonardo Bonucci never stopped running. He gets there first, and pokes it in. One each!

chapters.label: Follow it in
chapters.text: Want to score like Bonucci? When a teammate shoots, follow it in. Keep running, watch for the rebound, and be first to the ball.
